Job Posting: Project Coordinator
Source: Malawi Job Board
Date Captured: 2024-01-20

Position: Project Coordinator
Employer: Malawi Development Fund
Location: Blantyre, Malawi
Employment Type: Contract

Description:
We are seeking a Project Coordinator to support development initiatives in Malawi. The role involves coordinating project activities, monitoring progress, and ensuring deliverables are met on time and within budget.

Responsibilities:
- Plan and coordinate project activities
- Monitor project progress and report to stakeholders
- Ensure deliverables are met on time and within budget
- Support financial tracking and reporting

Requirements:
- 3+ years of project coordination experience
- Experience working in Malawi or similar development context
- Excellent organizational and communication skills
- Fluency in English and Chichewa

Closing Date: June 30, 2024

To apply, visit: https://malawi-jobs.example.com/pm-002
